notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Appropriations for this subchapter have not been authorized for fiscal years after 1975. Section 3871, Pub. L. 90–445, title III, § 301, as added Pub. L. 92–381, § 1, Aug. 14, 1972, 86 Stat. 535, related to technical assistance to agencies in matters relating to prevention of delinquency. A prior section 3871, Pub. L. 90–445, title III, § 301, July 31, 1968, 82 Stat. 470, related to development of improved techniques and practices for prevention of juvenile delinquency, prior to the general amendment of Pub. L. 90–445 by section 1 of Pub. L. 92–381. Provisions similar to those comprising this section were contained in prior section 3872, Pub. L. 90–445, title III, § 301, July 31, 1968, 82 Stat. 470, prior to the general amendment of Pub. L. 90–445 by section 1 of Pub. L. 92–381. Section 3872, Pub. L. 90–445, title III, § 302, as added Pub. L. 92–381, § 1, Aug. 14, 1972, 86 Stat. 535, related to State assistance to local units concerning activities under this chapter. A prior section 3872, Pub.
